about.title: About Me
about.paragraph_1: I'm Akhdan Ravi Andaman — a Software Engineer & Business Development Specialist based in Bogor, Indonesia. I hold a Bachelor of Applied Science in Software Engineering from IPB University (GPA 3.67/4.00) and am currently pursuing my Master’s degree in Systems and Information Technology at STEI Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB).
about.paragraph_2: My professional background spans mobile application development at Altvira Technology, systems integration at PT Mitra Graha Integrasi, and an intensive cohort at Bangkit Academy (Google, GoTo, Traveloka). On the engineering front, I build high-performance iOS/Android apps using Kotlin, Flutter, and React Native, alongside modern, full-stack web platforms using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
about.paragraph_3: Beyond pure coding, I drive strategic tech-business initiatives and import operations at PT Representasi Mitra Mandiri. Having also guided international travel groups as a Tour Leader, I combine sharp technical execution with cross-cultural communication, adaptability, and cross-functional leadership — shipping robust products that scale businesses.
